protocol: ONE FAIR-style postwarp intensity NGF pilot

validation.path_check: raster basenames plus side and sampling-affine values; relocated paths allowed, not content identity proof
validation.mask: fixed target coordinate inside original moving rectangle; no adaptive query dropping

512.stencil: central interior; first-order one-sided at both endpoints; hx=hy=1/side
512.edge_rule: max(side/255, .1 fixed-mask mean gradient norm), independently per frozen input
512.moving_calibration: original moving intensity sampled ONCE through initial affine; frozen thereafter
512.derivative: differentiate spatial gradient of freshly warped intensity; no moving-gradient transport or detach
512.flat_region_caution: flat moving intensity has zero NGF image gradient, even against a fixed edge
512.identity_caution: finite epsilon need not give zero identical-image loss or stationary map gradient

shared_frame: same original affine; NGF samples original intensity ONCE then takes fixed-frame gradients
changed_variable: shared-affine transported MIND replaced by squared-dot NGF of warped original intensity; same raster continuation
unchanged: same affine, boundary, four-corner floor, ARAP3, shape1e-4, matches.1, rates and 300 gradients
objective_caution: different data functional and sampling order; not pure geometry/optimizer evidence
timing: complete serial calls include setup/export; single calls, no warm ABBA speed claim
ngf_edge_rule: frozen per-scale max(side/255, .1 fixed-mask mean gradient norm), fixed and initial-warped moving separately
